S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  C482 No. 509 of 2023  Hon'ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Vikas Kumar Guglani, Advocate, for the applicant.
Mr. Atul Kumar Sah, Deputy A.G., with Mrs. Mamta Joshi, Brief Holder, for the State of Uttarakhand.

As per the FIR, which was got registered by the complainant/respondent No.2, herein, she has submitted, that she was in close intimate relationship with the present applicant for a quite long time, as admittedly they have got in contact with each other through social media.

It is admitted by the complainant/respondent No.2, that she had travelled from Delhi to Rudrapur on 1st November,
2020, and thereafter, she stayed in a hotel called as 'Chilana Tower'.
From there, the applicant took her to his sister's home at Sarda Colony, Rudrapur, on 3rd November, 2020.
The complainant/respondent No.2, further admits the fact, that later on, she was kept in the home of family friend of the applicant, where they stayed together and established physical relationship.

It is not even that, she has alleged in the FIR, that on a demand being raised by the applicant before marrying, she had even gone to Delhi to her parental home to bring the money, as it was alleged to be demanded by the present applicant.

Owing to the aforesaid backdrop, the registration of the FIR, being FIR No. 28 of 2021 dated 17th January, 2021, for the offence under Sections 376, 323, 504, 506 of the IPC, could not be apparently said to be made out, because it was a consensual relationship, and the complainant had been moving around with the present applicant for quite a long time at different places.
In that eventuality, let notices be issued to respondent No.2.
Steps to be taken by the applicant within a period of one week from today.

Mukesh Kohli, pending consideration before the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rudrapur,
District Udham Singh Nagar, would be kept in abeyance.
